$comment: Source of truth for the Scholarships hub. scripts/build_scholarships_index.py reads this to regenerate scholarships.html's card grid and sitemap.xml's scholarship-page entries — do not hand-edit scholarships.html's card list directly, edit this file instead and re-run the build script (or push, which triggers it automatically). New entries are added automatically by scripts/generate_scholarship_post.py, which only ever adds scholarships it can cite from an official source — human review happens via the GitHub PR it opens before anything is merged to main. Every entry here must have a matching scholarship-<slug>.html detail page.

scholarships.title: Chevening Scholarship 2027 (UK, Fully Funded Master's)
scholarships.summary: The UK government's flagship global scholarship funds a one-year taught master's degree at any UK university, covering tuition, a monthly stipend, airfare, and visa costs.
scholarships.meta_description: Chevening Scholarship 2027: fully funded UK master's degree for future leaders. Deadline 6 October 2026. Eligibility, benefits, and how to apply.

scholarships.title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship 2027/28 (UK, Fully Funded PhD & Master's)
scholarships.summary: A full-cost scholarship for outstanding applicants from outside the UK to pursue a full-time postgraduate degree at the University of Cambridge, covering tuition, maintenance, and more. Applications reopen in September 2026 for 2027/28 entry.
scholarships.meta_description: Gates Cambridge Scholarship 2027/28: fully funded PhD and master's study at Cambridge for non-UK citizens. Applications open September 2026, deadlines from 14 October 2026.
scholarships.funder: Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation / University of Cambridge
